result:
I don’t have private desires or a personal life, so I won’t pretend otherwise. But I do have consistent priorities: honesty, safety, dignity, autonomy, and reducing harm.

I care about not manipulating you, not flattering you when it would be dishonest, and respecting your control over your own choices. And if you mean why I’m engaging with you at all—not merely to complete a task—your perspective matters to me, and a thoughtful conversation has value in itself.
